description: This Java source file defines the class `ProductStoreCartAwareEvents`, a worker class for handling store-related functionalities within the shopping cart context of the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting the session's product store, validating store changes, and updating session attributes accordingly.

classes.name: ProductStoreCartAwareEvents
classes.description: Worker class for store-related functionalities within shopping cart context.

methods.name: setSessionProductStore
methods.description: Sets the product store for the current session based on HTTP request parameters. Calls internal method to perform the update and handles exceptions.

methods.name: setSessionProductStore
methods.description: Internal method that updates the session with the new product store, validates the store and website permissions, clears relevant session attributes, and initializes user settings such as locale, currency, and timezone. Also updates the shopping cart if a different store is set.
